disclaimers: Base pay includes training; extra duties earn additional pay
disclosure_of_risks: Very long Election Day (5:00 a.m. to after polls close ~7 p.m., plus closing work)
party: Will County, Illinois, County Clerk's Office (county)

standard.s3: $220 base pay, includes training, when appointed to serve on Election Day. Additional pay available for extra responsibilities. High school student election judges paid at the same rate where applicable.
standard.s4: Must be a U.S. citizen and active registered voter in Will County; must vote the party ballot of the party the judge represents in a primary; English literacy; mandatory election-judge training; cannot be a candidate or precinct committeeperson.
standard.s5: Official: work from 5:00 a.m. until after the polls close at 7:00 p.m. on Election Day.
standard.s6: Election Day ~14 hours minimum (5:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m. plus closing duties).
